$comment: Production target for bun run release:run (D61). It names where production lives and nothing of what runs there: no release commit (the go file's line names it, and SP.8 refuses a commit the stage run did not pass at), no previous commit, no running stack (the host's smoke state names it; the rolling boot replaces it one service at a time, website-server kept). Fill confirmTarget with host:port/database from rm-frontend-prod-1's /root/.env before the run. The run refuses the placeholder, and P02-identity refuses a value that differs from what the host resolves.
